description: This source file defines the ProgramAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of EpgProgram objects in an Android application. It includes a view holder class and binds program data to UI elements.

classes.name: ProgramAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter used to display a list of EpgProgram instances.

classes.name: ProgramVH
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for ProgramAdapter that manages the individual item view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ProgramVH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a program item to the view holder at a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of program items.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an EpgProgram data object to the UI components within the ViewHolder.
